output.reason: The changelog line [ev-d6f69b890b45] and PR #11776 [ev-9827a4a989a9] [ev-9f4c71354d73] give the subject and the change: the Loki background cache (pkg/storage/chunk/cache/background.go) counted each enqueued key twice in its queue size, and the fix removes the extra increment. They do not cover the open aspect, applicability. No evidence names the configuration that turns on the background (write-back) cache or says which deployments run it. WriteBackGoroutines appears only as a test setting [ev-268c4db34db0]. The PR also only implies, through TestBackgroundSizeLimit, that the inflated size could hit a size limit and drop writes; it never says so, so whether this goes beyond a wrong metric is unclear. To write an applicability condition an engine can evaluate, we need the config docs or the code that enables the background cache and enforces its size limit.
